findings.description: AWS access key material is embedded in the Lambda environment variables. This exposes credentials in Terraform source and state, and makes them available to code or principals able to read the function configuration.
The function uses nodejs12.x, an end-of-life runtime that no longer receives security updates, increasing exposure to known runtime vulnerabilities.
